flows:
Navigate to https://www.euronext.com/en then Work exclusively inside the Reading view dialog.
Use only its listed roles, names and controls.
Report a barrier if the exact named control does not exist; an unnamed control is not a substitute.
Test the exact target and report the outcome once.
Stay on this public site.
Do not sign in, register, pay, or interact with a CAPTCHA or access challenge.
Leave fixture settings unchanged.
Use visible controls only.
In Reading view, locate the textbox named “Sites search”.
Enter the text test and confirm the field contains it.
Do not submit.
Get the text in the textbox named “Sites search” and save it as {{sites_search_value}}.
